note.hint: mamelet reports it in its round after this plan; if a later plan still waits, the declarations planned name more groups of app than the 16 mamelet observes of one user, and the declaration in force keeps its own first: approve and apply this plan (on the Control Plane's host: mamela approve <digest>, then mamela apply), after which mamelet observes this declaration's

warnings.message: user app is added to group docker on web: its members control the Docker daemon, which runs containers as root with the host's files, so the user can become root there
warnings.hint: declare the group only if the user is meant to administer the node; Mamela never removes a membership, so taking it out of the declaration later does not take it away
